purpose: The claims the third September 2026 candidate set requires of the ledger before its packages are published: the native baselines, the reference operator with its complete export, the registry, the custody and interoperability profiles this repository implements and tests. Every claim that names a standard this repository has not mapped, an operation it has not demonstrated or a product it has not qualified is withheld by name.

claims.rationale: Two processes under one administration prove the synchronisation mechanism and never independence; EXPORT-3-durable-publication is a gap until separately administered operators exercise replication and recovery.
The upstream context and executable suite are unavailable at the pinned revision; only the implemented subset is claimed.

The UNTP 0.7.0 schemas and context are pinned by digest, but the application pilot names no UNTP context and validates nothing against them, and UNTP's own tooling verifies Ed25519 under did:web only; the profile remains proposed.
No normative EN text has been read; every EN row is unassessed or a gap, and the release set makes no European conformity statement. The selection eu-dpp-system-2026-09 is the gate for that claim.
prEN 18239:2025 and prEN 18246:2025 are drafts whose text has not been read; nothing is claimed against them.
battery@3 is a draft profile; the Annex XIII mapping is unassessed and product-data compliance is a separate qualification from this release.
No implementation by another implementing party has passed every fixture; the programme-authored Python reader is engineering evidence, not independence.

notes: The qualification of this selection says which claims the ledger's evidence supports for the packages of the candidate set. It is not a statement about the deployed index, the registry runtime, the application, product compliance or any European standard.
